strengths.mechanism: Required personality and greeting with optional fine-tuning.
strengths.benefitInference: Beginners can establish a premise before learning controls.

strengths.mechanism: Versioned retries, targeted correction, Scenarios, and history navigation.
strengths.benefitInference: Users can repair replies and revisit divergence points.

strengths.mechanism: Reply-level recall inspection and memory editing.
strengths.benefitInference: Continuity problems become easier to diagnose.

strengths.mechanism: Call/text continuity settings and persistent versus temporary media configuration.
strengths.benefitInference: Users can change mode or experiment with less repeated setup.

tradeoffs.note: Scenarios need subscription/group capacity; bounded copying excludes unshown call context. Rewind has eligibility limits.
Cascaded Memory is hidden; recall inspection is partial and retrieval fallible.
Group participation can affect individual memories; group existence does not establish story isolation.
Kin creation offers Male or Female; personas also offer Nonbinary.
Export normally has a 30-day interval and links media. Lapsed accounts retain read-only access and export.
Shared templates exclude history, journals, long-term memory, custom voices, and avatar boosts.
Parallel text chat with Shared chat history during calls can cause undefined behavior and lost memory.
Mobile image moderation can remove generated selfies with automatic credit refund.

unknowns.note: Full prompt inspection, arbitrary provider connections, external character-card import, export restoration, and self-hosting are not established.
Current default selfie model is unresolved: selfie guidance names Atelier, October 12 changelog names Vignette.
No recall-quality, latency, mobile usability, accessibility, recovery, or export round-trip tests.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Lead creation with premise and greeting, then disclose expert controls.
Place recalled material and correction beside each reply.
Explain operation scope before retry, edit, rewind, or branch.
Separate saved media defaults from request overrides.

doNotCopy.pattern: Hidden memory as the only continuity mechanism.
doNotCopy.reason: Users need to understand what survives resets.

doNotCopy.pattern: Bounded Scenario presented as an exact checkpoint.
doNotCopy.reason: Copied text does not establish complete state preservation.

doNotCopy.pattern: Template sharing presented as a backup.
doNotCopy.reason: Explicit sharing exclusions omit story state.
